conflicts.decision: Manual section8.8.8 is authoritative: CCNT/CREPEAT RO. Keep SVD/header bytes unchanged and add existing-format register access corrections on all five exposed views.
conflicts.other_source_fact: Pinned SVD register+field access and CMSIS __IOM are RW.

conflicts.decision: Promote exactly TC/TE RO into the existing field-access sidecar, including aggregate views; retain STATUS RW.
conflicts.other_source_fact: Original SVD/header/manual agree; canonical IR alone loses field access.

conflicts.decision: Do not copy DMA_ClearInterruptFlag: channel shift and public mask domain disagree with manual ICR positions. Use native ICR all-ones seed, clear only own observed flags.
conflicts.other_source_fact: DMA_INTERRUPT_TC/TE are CSR TCIE/TEIE bits1/2; ICR TC/TE are bits0/1 with stride4.

conflicts.decision: Do not copy helper that writes only transfer_size into CNT and leaves REPEAT=0. Own manual requires REPEAT nonzero and REPEAT1 for intermittent peripheral events.

proof_boundaries: The original CCNT/CREPEAT source access remains read-write; only reviewed authored/PAC whole-register access becomes Read.
Original CSR TC/TE are read-only inside read-write registers; ten sidecar restrictions preserve those source facts while STATUS remains writable.
Four native enums are authored for L012 only, with SIZE3 and STATUS6/7 unqualified.
Source bindings, package rows and hashes are evidence of source consistency; no MCU transfer, wire output, drain latency, electrical behavior or fault injection was observed.
The generic CW32L012 record is inventory only and has no safe owned-DMA SRAM admission.
Current CCNT is a sampled remaining element count under REPEAT1, not a terminal or bus-drain guarantee.
UART1 is the own explicit SRAM-byte DMA example; UART2/3 use the own common UARTx layout and request table.
SDK clear-helper mask domain and channel shift, and zero-REPEAT helper configuration, are explicitly rejected.
The all-ones native ICR command seed preserves sibling and reserved bits; zero Default and read-modify-write are not command authority.
